record.question: Which electrolyte imbalance is commonly associated with renal failure in critically ill patients?
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Hyperkalemia. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 13, printed Q55. Source limitation: Multiple offered electrolyte abnormalities can be associated with renal failure; no “most common” or specific renal/critical-care context is provided. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
